criteria.C1_zone_free: all r1 zone-free frames (5 poses x 2 ticks = 10): no detection and largest band component < 600 px
criteria.C2_nonzone_fp0: all ablated lane frames, both robots (10 poses x 2 robots x 2 ticks = 40): detector returns nothing and largest band component < 600 px
criteria.C3_step_a_r1_detect: all r1 Step A frames (6 x x 2 ticks = 12): detection present
criteria.C4_no_floor_merge: every lane frame with a detection (both robots): left/right/bottom bbox edges within edge_tol_px of the zone-only largest component

selection_rule: B0 if C1-C4 all pass on v5; else the first of B1, B2 (in that order) with C1-C4 all pass; else NO_BAND_PASSED -> stop, report, do not run Step B, do not add a new band after seeing results

step_b.when: only if selection.step_b_allowed; one run, same frozen prereg
step_b.order: ① solo r1 diagnostic (not a gate; stop ② if r1 does not pass the door) -> ② 2-robot Step B
step_b.acceptance: GT 2/2 AND claim 2/2 AND mismatch 0 AND FP 0 AND boundary 0 (identical to PREREG_V230_R5)
step_b.eval_only: robot-robot min distance/contact, robot-scene contact, command/GT ratio
step_b.no_pooling: v5 results are a separate condition from the v6 r5 PASS (2026-10-20)

stop_rules: sweep HOST_ERROR -> no verdict, fix, new out root, rerun once
